Subject: Proof-of-Concept workshop — availability & sample payload question

Hi Logan / team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Atlas Health data team is excited to try a hands-on session. We want to lock a half-day working session (POC workshop) focused on: prompt review, routing behavior for triage flows, and a short load check (representative throughput for a subset of endpoints). Our initial constraints:

- Prefer Dec 14–17, mornings PT.
- We'll bring 10–20 sample prompts and a ~48-hour synthetic QA set for evaluation.
- A big ask: we need a redaction checklist up front (we handle PHI carefully).

Can you: 1) confirm available windows, 2) share a short checklist/template for redaction and sample formatting, and 3) advise on secure transfer (S3 presigned vs Drive)?

I've attached an initial data manifest with the sample file list.

Thanks,
Emma

Subject: Re: Proof-of-Concept workshop — availability & sample payload question

Hi Emma — great to hear, and we can absolutely support the scope you described. High level notes and next steps: 

1) Availability
- We have slots on Dec 15 (09:00–13:00 PT) or Dec 16 (09:00–13:00 PT). Both are half-day hands-on sessions with product + solutions engineering. Please confirm a preferred date/time.

2) Redaction & sample formatting (quick checklist)
- Remove direct patient identifiers (name, SSN, MRN) unless absolutely necessary — replace with stable tokens (e.g., [PATIENT_123]).
- Convert timestamps to relative (e.g., days-since-event) where possible.
- Keep labels for key fields: prompt_id, conversation_type, expected_label (if you have QA).
- Max prompt length recommendation: 4k tokens for workshop samples (we can handle longer for hosted tests).
- Provide a small evaluation set (50–200 items) with expected outputs for regression checks.

I attached a redaction_template.docx and a proposed agenda (agenda-v1.pdf).

3) Secure transfer
- Preferred: s3 presigned URL (short TTL) or our encrypted transfer endpoint — we also accept a shared Drive folder for small files. I'll put a brief S3 transfer SOP in the Drive link after you confirm the date.

4) Load test parameters
- For the working session we recommend a representative spike: 5 concurrent workers, target 10–15 req/s sustained per endpoint for 10 minutes. If you have peak numbers, send them and we'll tailor the plan.

If that all looks good I'll send a calendar invite and a short intake form (2–3 questions) so we can map prompts to routing policies and the evaluation harness.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai
Attachments: redaction_template.docx (stub), agenda-v1.pdf (stub)
